**1.002: Paragraphs in Transcription Mode, your choice of how.**

- **Paragraphs setting** in Transcription (the menu in the Transcript header): *None* (one block of text), *Time-based* (a new paragraph about every 30 seconds, as before) or *Paragraph model*. The setting is remembered.
- **Paragraph model** is a small English classifier that reads the finished transcript and starts paragraphs where the topic moves on. It only adds line breaks; it never changes your words. It runs on your computer, once, when transcription finishes. Picking it the first time downloads it (34 MB). If it's missing or fails, that transcript gets time-based paragraphs and the status line says so.
- Switching the setting after a transcript re-flows it, as long as you haven't edited the text. Dictation (hotkey, Talk button, overlay) is unchanged.
- Ubuntu 26.04 .deb and a portable Windows zip. Not yet tested on Windows hardware. Downloads: [hebrish.app/download](https://hebrish.app/download).
